# lago_webhook_endpoint (Resource)

Manages a Lago webhook endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    lago = {
      source  = "registry.opentofu.org/rpcpool/lago"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "lago" {
  api_endpoint = var.lago_api_endpoint
  api_key      = var.lago_api_key
}

resource "lago_webhook_endpoint" "main" {
  webhook_url    = "https://example.com/webhooks/lago"
  signature_algo = "hmac"
}

variable "lago_api_endpoint" {
  type = string
}

variable "lago_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `webhook_url` (String) URL to which Lago will send webhook events. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `signature_algo` (String) Algorithm used to sign webhook payloads. Allowed values: `jwt`, `hmac`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Webhook endpoint creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Terraform resource ID, set to the webhook endpoint Lago UUID.
- `lago_id` (String) Lago internal UUID for the webhook endpoint.
